$comment: Single definition of which CI checks gate a merge (#1410). required = runs on every PR and blocks: GitHub branch protection AND the in-app auto-merge. conditional = path-filtered, blocks only when it runs: auto-merge only, NEVER branch protection (an unreported required context is pending forever). advisory = reported, never blocks. `name` must equal the reported check-run name exactly (matrix jobs expand, e.g. 'Build (ubuntu-latest)'). Validated by `node scripts/gates/quality-gates.cjs --check` in CI; branch protection is generated from this file with `--print-protection <branch>`.

checks.name: Secret scanning
checks.reason: A leaked credential cannot be un-merged; gitleaks scans every PR.

checks.name: Lint Code
checks.reason: Backend/frontend tsc, eslint, prettier and the repo's docs/boundary checks.

checks.name: Check Frontend
checks.reason: Frontend type check and the required frontend test manifest.

checks.name: Check Rust Code
checks.reason: cargo fmt/clippy plus the scripts/**/*.test.cjs, repo-hygiene and docs-drift gates.

checks.name: Check Rust Code (Windows)
checks.reason: The desktop app ships on Windows; clippy and cargo test there catch platform-only breakage.

checks.name: Test Backend
checks.reason: The backend gate suite (scripts/ci-gate-tests.txt) against PostgreSQL.

checks.name: Test SQLite Compatible Suite
checks.reason: The desktop build runs on SQLite; this keeps the provider-specific paths green.

checks.name: CodeQL Analysis (javascript)
checks.reason: PR #769 merged with a new high alert before CodeQL finished (task 950).

checks.name: CodeQL Analysis (typescript)
checks.reason: Same matrix job as the javascript leg; both languages must pass.

checks.name: Dependency Security Check
checks.reason: Trivy filesystem scan for known-vulnerable dependencies.

checks.name: NPM Security Audit
checks.reason: npm/pnpm audit against .github/audit-exceptions.json.

checks.name: Rust Security Audit
checks.reason: cargo audit for the Tauri crate graph.

checks.name: Build (ubuntu-latest)
checks.reason: Never merge code that does not build into the desktop app.

checks.name: Build (macos-latest)
checks.reason: Release platform; both macOS targets report under this one name.

checks.name: Build (windows-latest)
checks.reason: Primary release platform.

checks.name: Enforce per-file line limits (with ratchet baseline)
checks.reason: Path-filtered to source files. The ratchet was decorative until 2026-08-30: nine files crossed the hard limit while PRs merged past a red check.

checks.name: Enforce HACK/FIXME ceilings (ADR-0004)
checks.reason: Path-filtered to source files; PR #703 sat 3+ days red on this while the task read completed (task 950).

checks.name: Lint GitHub Actions workflows
checks.reason: Runs only when workflow files change; a broken workflow can silently stop every other gate.

checks.name: Lint Markdown files
checks.reason: Runs only when Markdown changes. NOTE: the job is continue-on-error ('advisory until the existing Markdown is brought up to spec'), yet auto-merge has blocked on its failures since before #1410; kept as-is so this change does not alter merge behaviour. Decide one or the other.

checks.name: Quick Build Check
checks.reason: Runs only when app code changes; the fast build gate the auto-merge has always waited on.

checks.name: Route Regression
checks.reason: Runs on every PR but has never been required or auto-merge blocking; promote to required once its green rate on develop is measured.

checks.name: Frozen Install Verification
checks.reason: Proves the committed lockfiles install frozen; runs on every PR but was never made blocking. Candidate for required.

checks.name: Full Suite (Advisory)
checks.reason: continue-on-error: the whole backend suite including tests not yet in the gate manifest. Tests graduate into scripts/ci-gate-tests.txt instead of this job becoming required.

checks.name: Test Order Dependency Check
checks.reason: continue-on-error until `bun run test:shuffle` passes 10 consecutive develop runs (escalation criterion in the workflow).

checks.name: Create Release
checks.reason: Not a PR gate: runs only on v* tag pushes.

checks.name: Restart Loop Smoke
checks.reason: Path-filtered to the backend and never auto-merge blocking; candidate for conditional once its flake rate is known.

checks.name: Fault Injection E2E
checks.reason: continue-on-error: replays fault scenarios through the real recovery paths; informational until its scenarios stabilise.

checks.name: Knip (frontend)
checks.reason: continue-on-error: unused-export report, not a correctness gate.

checks.name: Check frontend bundle size
checks.reason: continue-on-error: size trend report.

checks.name: Backend Performance
checks.reason: Measurement report; shared-runner timings are too noisy to block on.

checks.name: Frontend Bundle Size
checks.reason: Measurement report; shared-runner timings are too noisy to block on.

checks.name: Post Preview Info
checks.reason: Posts a PR comment; not a check of the code.

checks.name: Review dependency changes
checks.reason: Path-filtered to manifests/lockfiles; the blocking vulnerability gates are the NPM/Rust audits and Trivy.

checks.name: Bun Lockfile Check
checks.reason: Path-filtered lockfile hygiene; Frozen Install Verification is the stronger check.

checks.name: Verify version is in sync across manifests
checks.reason: Path-filtered to version manifests; drift matters at release time, which re-runs it on main.

checks.name: Close issues named by merged PRs
checks.reason: Post-merge housekeeping on pull_request closed; never runs before a merge.
